conditions.value_template: {{ trigger.to_state is not none and trigger.to_state.attributes.get('package') == 'com.google.android.apps.maps' and trigger.to_state.attributes.get('category') == 'navigation' }}

data.message: {% set sub = trigger.to_state.attributes.get('android.subText', '') | string %}{% set f = sub | regex_findall('Arrive (\\d{1,2}:\\d{2} [AP]M)') %}Caleb is on his way home.{% if f %}{% set t = strptime(f[0], '%I:%M %p') %}{% set mins = ((as_timestamp(today_at('%02d:%02d' | format(t.hour, t.minute))) - now().timestamp()) / 60) | round(0) | int %}{% if 0 < mins < 90 %} About {{ mins }} minutes away.{% endif %}{% endif %}
